title: VX-One: Typed, Calibrated Decision Heads for Real-Time Perimeter Triage - An empirical study of unknown-attack honesty, cascade gray zones, and calibration under drift
abstract: arXiv:2610.30090v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Perimeter triage faces a latency/semantics trade-off: signature engines are fast and format-safe but blind to unseen attacks, while generative models are semantic but slow and produce unparseable output. In late 2026 a class of commercial System One decision models (TypeSafe Jev; Microsoft-Decision-1) began selling typed decision primitives - binary gates, closed-set choices, ordinal scores - as product APIs, with no academic treatment. We present VX-One: a small multi-head network (100K-10M parameters) whose outputs are these primitives - a calibrated gate, a choice over a closed candidate set that always includes an explicit unknown option, and an ordinal score, trained multi-task, temperature-calibrated per head (~0.7-1.7 ms p50 on CPU). We evaluate it on UNSW-NB15, CIC-IDS2017, EMBER2024 against calibrated XGBoost, Random-Forest, MLP, Kitsune, and measure a two-phase cascade (Suricata with 52,674 Emerging-Threats rules -> VX-One) o

translated_title: VX-One：面向实时边界分流的有类型、经校准的决策头——关于未知攻击诚实性、级联灰色地带与漂移下校准的实证研究
translated_abstract: 边界分流面临延迟与语义之间的权衡：签名引擎快速且格式安全，但对未见过的攻击无能为力，而生成式模型虽具备语义理解能力却速度缓慢且会产生无法解析的输出。2026年末，一类商用System One决策模型（TypeSafe Jev；Microsoft-Decision-1）开始将有类型的决策原语——二值门控、闭集选择、序数分数——作为产品API出售，但学术界尚无相关研究。我们提出VX-One：一个小型多头网络（参数量10万至1000万），其输出即为这些原语——一个经校准的门控、一个在始终包含显式未知选项的封闭候选集上的选择，以及一个序数分数，采用多任务方式训练，并对每个头进行温度校准（CPU上p50延迟约为0.7-1.7毫秒）。我们在UNSW-NB15、CIC-IDS2017、EMBER2024数据集上将其与经校准的XGBoost、随机森林、MLP、Kitsune进行对比评估，并测量了一个两阶段级联系统（配备52,674条Emerging-Threats规则的Suricata -> VX-One）……
tldr: 本文提出VX-One，一个将商用有类型决策原语（校准门控、含显式未知选项的闭集选择、序数分数）作为输出的小型多头网络，在CPU上以毫秒级延迟实现实时边界分流，并实证评估了未知攻击诚实性、级联灰色地带与漂移下的校准性能。
en_tdlr: VX-One is a small multi-head network that outputs typed, calibrated decision primitives (a calibrated gate, a closed-set choice with an explicit unknown option, and an ordinal score) for real-time perimeter triage at millisecond-level CPU latency, with empirical evaluation of unknown-attack honesty, cascade gray zones, and calibration under drift.
